anchor_sentence.description: exact sentence from the article the edit, footnote, or comment attaches to

passage.description: for drafted_edit: the exact current passage being replaced, copied from the article

note_text.description: for footnote: the short self-contained note, citing the evidence

comment.description: for editorial_escalation: the anchored editor comment stating the finding and what to reconsider

reason.description: why this scope and why the text is adequate, or why none is
